description: Open-loop check on identical inputs (seed 0 random images/state/noise; real LIBERO instructions tokenized by the checkpoint's LeRobot tokenizer step). PyTorch = SmolVLAPolicy.model.sample_actions FP32 CUDA, full untruncated instruction. ONNX = FP32 monolithic graphs, ONNX Runtime CUDA EP, instruction truncated/padded to the static width.
